prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
adoption, new_flow changes were helpful, producing a confirmed winning test (though later tests showed no clear effect).
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder changes were tested twice each and showed no positive effect, with some tests worsening performance.
home, wait_info changes were tested twice and showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types (including home, new_flow) as each has only been tested once.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Naming & Care Pledge Flow: Adds a new care pledge step before adoption certificate where users set basic care preferences and sign an interactive adoption pledge. (why: Adoption step drops to 63.3% conversion with a very high mean time (1017s); introducing a warm pledge flow builds commitment before finalization.)
1: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Stage Layout: Switches the adoption certificate screen layout to a side-by-side split layout showing pet visual preview beside details. (why: Adoption conversion is low (63.3%); presenting details and companion side-by-side streamlines approval.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Controls Guide Screen: Adds a new dedicated screen after home_intro demonstrating basic desktop interactions like dragging, clicking, and hiding the pet. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received multiple emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Notification Toggle: Enables a desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while pet assets build and miss completion.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Spotlight Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated pet mascot showcasing key app highlights. (why: Choose path screen mean time is 514s despite 8s median, showing long tail hesitation at entry.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Best Practices Tip: Adds an inline carousel tip on the photo upload screen explaining optimal lighting and angles for custom pets. (why: Support mail received 3 bug reports regarding custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress & Time Display: Shows a step counter and active completion time estimate on the waiting screen during asset preparation. (why: Home step mean duration is very high (2336s), indicating uncertainty while waiting for background processing.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Directives Copy: Updates choose_path headline and body text to clearly differentiate Quick Starter vs Custom Creator options. (why: 76.2% conversion on choose_path with a 514s mean time points to friction and decision paralysis at initial selection.)
